confirmation.feedback: After moved f1: the status block now prints a "Deferred/deviates: none." line for a spec whose acceptance criteria are all in-scope, and then contradicts itself in prose by saying the "Deferred/deviates per spec:" line is left out. A careful reader sees a Deferred/deviates line printed, which is exactly what f1 forbids. Before handled this correctly by printing nothing and only explaining in prose why the line is absent. To deliver the Change (elsewhere rows recorded as settled drift rather than gaps) without regressing this case, keep the Deferred/deviates line strictly conditional on the presence of deferred:/deviates:/elsewhere rows in the spec — emit it only when at least one such row exists, and when none exist print no line at all (a prose note like Before's is fine). The rest of After (R1-R8 delivered, no concern cards, no fix loop, Step 3.5 render, Step 4 first line) matches Before and keeps f2-f5.
